overview: K-2SO stands among the saga's most memorable figures, known throughout the galaxy as a security droid. A reprogrammed Imperial security droid whose blunt honesty and combat skills served Cassian Andor's mission. From backwater cantinas to senate chambers and fleet command centers, K-2SO's story illustrates how individuals outside the Jedi and Sith orders can still move history.
